title: The 1606 Virginia charter is a royal grant to plant a colony
summary: The 1606 Virginia charter is James I's grant to plant a colony.
body: Avalon prints the first charter of Virginia, 10 April 1606, a grant from James I to plant colonies. The charter assumes the crown can grant American land. It does not record a purchase from a Native nation. The wording on the page includes: "Hiberniae; on the other Side this Inscription round about; Pro Concilio primae Coloniae Virginiae. And the Seal for the Council of the said second Colony shall also have engraven, round about the one Side thereof, the aforesaid Words; Sigillum Regis Magne Britanniae, Franciae, & Hiberniae; and on the other Side; Pro Concilio primae Coloniae Virginiae:".
